title: Recruitment of Retired Employees for Special Judicial Magistrate Courts
summary: Banda District Court has issued a notification for the engagement of retired employees from the District Court and Collectorate for Special Judicial Magistrate-First and Special Judicial Magistrate-Second courts. Eligible retired candidates can submit their handwritten applications to the office of the undersigned by 02 Dec 2026.
eligibility_bullets: Reader: Must be a retired employee from District Courts or Collectorate with age not exceeding 65 years.
Ahlmad: Must be a retired employee from District Courts or Collectorate with age not exceeding 65 years.
Peon: Must be a retired employee from District Courts or Collectorate with age not exceeding 65 years.
